messages:
maria: quick PSA — ripgrep update on content-sweep accidentally changed a handful of anchor ids in the runbooks (we use --replace in the script). I found 4 runtime-guide links that 404. Minimal fix: sed restore or revert the change. Repro steps below.

maria: Command that ran in CI (approx):
```bash
rg --files -0 | xargs -0 sed -i 's/runbook-old-anchor/runbook-new-anchor/g'
```

aj: can you paste the exact sed you'd recommend? I can open a tiny PR for runtime-guide.

maria: Proposed revert (tested locally on a sample):
```bash
sed -E -i 's/runbook-new-anchor/runbook-old-anchor/g' $(rg -l "runbook-new-anchor")
```

sam: I'll run link-checker post-PR. @docs-bot can we rerun kb-link-scan once merged?

docs-bot: scheduled kb-link-scan for refs/heads/docs/ripgrep-fix in ~5m :white_check_mark:

ivan: FYI a couple of anchors were intentionally moved in the ja/ localization branch — please limit the revert to en/ and runtime guides only, or we'll create merge conflicts for ja/.

aj: noted. I'll limit the PR to runtime-guide/ and runtime-onboarding/ only. prepping now.

maria: thanks. small ask: add a one-line changelog in PR body 'revert accidental anchor rename — ripgrep sweep' and tag @docs-ops for quick approval.

sam: pinged @docs-ops. I'll verify that the link-checker result goes green before merging.

aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — small sed + test. @maria can you quick-look? :eyes:

maria: LGTM, left tiny nit about commit message. I can squash+merge after link-check pass.

aj: merging in 2m if green.
